summary: Use direct-library activation for governed browser continuity.
details: The server and two-client lifecycle retain one governed process tree and private writable run state. Each phase activates its exact selection in the configured master library; phase changes wait for owned processes to stop, and previous controls are restored.

Candidate admission retains source-patch and authored README checks. Controlled actor/input tests and historical results remain separate from current native multiplayer, physical-input and release acceptance.
